verdict.rationale: Stripe documents several automations that run autonomously once configured — Smart Retries and revenue-recovery workflows automatically retry failed payments, Billing automates recurring charges/trials/renewals, webhooks push real-time events for downstream automation, and Radar uses AI to assess fraud risk in real time — all without ongoing manual intervention. However, these are payment-specific automations rather than a general agentic automation framework; there's no evidence of a scheduler/orchestration layer for AI agents to define arbitrary autonomous background tasks beyond Stripe's own billing/fraud pipelines. Missing for 10: evidence of user-configurable agent-driven background workflows beyond billing/fraud/webhooks, and independent/hands-on corroboration that these automations run reliably unattended.
